codes.title: Okhiye bencazelo namakhodi womugqa
codes.keys.lede: Ukhiye ufana nekhodi lensimu elisemqaleni wencazelo (* = noma yimaphi amagama, ? = olulodwa) bese lifaka iphoyinti eqenjini, nomsebenzi nencazelo ende. Ukhiye wokuqala ofanayo uyawina; amakhodi angafani nanoma yikiphi ukhiye ahlala eyiqembu lawo.
codes.col.label: Incazelo
codes.lines.on: Hlanganisa amaphoyinti abe imigqa ngamakhodi womugqa
codes.lines.lede: Ikhodi yomugqa yilelo gama elilandela ngokushesha ikhodi yensimu: "EP B" iqala umugqa omusha wemphetho wendlela, "EP E" uyaphetha, "BLDG C" uvala isakhiwo ubuyele enkonjaneni yokuqala. Amaphoyinti anekhodi efanayo ahlanganiswa ngokulandelana kwenombolo yephoyinti; i-EP1 ne-EP2 yimigqa ehlukene. Amaqembu wokuphula alandela lezi zimigqa; imigqa yamanye amaqembu idwetshwa eplanini.

se.head: Ukuphakama kwejika
se.off.note: Ngokuphakama kwejika kuvuliwe, amalane azungeza umugqa wephakathi kulo jika: ilane langaphandle lilinganiswa, bese lonke umgwaqo uthambeka ngasohlangothini lwangaphakathi lwejika, bese ubuyela ngemva kwalo.
se.rate.e.of: Izinga lokuphakama lomugqa {n}, ngamaphesenti (okungenalutho = ukhahlo oluvamile)
se.rate.note: Ijika lithatha izinga lomugqa wokuqala iradiyasi yalo ifinyelela kuwo. Lawa mazinga nethambeka le-0.5 % kuyizinani zesikhashana, hhayi izinga elisemthethweni: yisethe ngokwemigomo yakho yoyilo. Ukubuya = ububanzi lelane × e ÷ ithambeka; ukuphuma = ukhahlo oluvamile ÷ e × ukubuya; izingxenye ezimbili kwezintathu zokubuya zisemuva kwejika.

dr.note: Q = C × i × A, kufingqwa phansi konethiwekhi: ipayipi ngalinye lithwala zonke izindawo zokuqoqa ezingaphezulu kwalo ngesikhathi eside kunazo zonke sokugxila, nezikhathi zokuhamba kumapayipi agcwele. i: {i}, Q: {q}, A: {a}. Ijika lamandla, n nokulahleka endaweni yokuhlangana kuzinombolo ezibekiwe, hhayi izinga elisemthethweni: zisethe ngedatha yakho yemvula nezinqubomgomo zakho zokwakha.

dr.none: Azikho izindawo zokuqoqa okwamanje. Dweba izindawo ezihamba amanzi ayo ngakwesakhiwo ngasinye ukuze uthole ukugeleza, usayizi wamapayipi nomugqa wezinga lomfutho wamanzi.
dr.c.head: Indawo yokuqoqa
dr.c.name: Igama
dr.c.note: C iyingxenye yemvula egeleza phansi (0 kuya 1). Isikhathi sokugxila yisikhathi amanzi asithatha ukusuka endaweni ekude kakhulu kuya esakhiweni sayo.
dr.c.few: Indawo yokuqoqa idinga amakona okungenani amathathu.
dr.c.nonet: Qala udweba unethiwekhi yamapayipi: indawo yokuqoqa ihamba amanzi ayo ngakwesinye sezakhiwo zayo.
dr.ok: Wonke amapayipi ageleza ngokugcwele ngokuphakathi futhi umugqa wezinga lomfutho wamanzi usala ngaphansi kwawo wonke amaphethelo.
dr.size.note: Ipayipi ngalinye lithola usayizi omncane osemthethweni ongathwala ukugeleza kwalo ngokwehla kwalo. Amazinga angezansi (inverts) ahlala lapho ayikhona: uwasethe futhi ngemithetho uma usayizi eshintsha.
rt.head: Hambisa isiphepho
rt.lead: Indlela yokulinganisa (rational) inikeza ukuphakama kunye kuphela kwepayipi ngalinye. Lokhu kusebenza isiphepho sonke: ukugeleza kwendawo ngayinye phakathi nesikhathi, kudluliselwe phansi kumapayipi nesikhathi sokuhamba nesitoreji, bese kwengezwa lapho zihlangana.
rt.none: Akukho okuhanjiswayo okwamanje: dweba indawo yokuqoqa ehamba amanzi ayo ngakwesakhiwo, bese unikeza amapayipi ububanzi nokwehla.
rt.method: Ipayipi ngalinye lihanjiswa ngendlela ye-Muskingum–Cunge. Ukugcwala ngaphezulu, ukubuyela emuva kwamanzi, isitoreji ezakhiweni nokukhukhula akulingiswanga: ipayipi elidlula amandla alo liyaphawulwa, namanzi alo adluliselwa njengokungathi ayalingana. Sebenzisa ukubona isikhathi nokuncipha, hhayi ukulinganisa ipayipi.
rt.long: Isiphepho side kunalokho okulingiswa yithuluzi: ingxenye yokugcina yokusebenza iyasikwa.

crs.prj.name: Kusuka kufayela le-.prj
crs.prj.unit: I-.prj isebenzisa iyunithi i-CivilCraft ingayisekeli (amamitha, amafidi kuphela namafidi wokuhlola wase-US).
crs.prj.nomatch: I-.prj ayihambisani ngokuphelele nohlelo oluku-uhlu; kusetshenziswa incazelo yayo yona.
crs.p.deg: Iphrojekthi idinga uhlelo olunomklamo (easting nenyakatho). Ubude nobubanzi bomhlaba buyizinto zamafayela e-GIS, hhayi amakhoordinethi omdwebo.
crs.p.unit: I-CivilCraft isebenza ngezinhlelo ezisemamitheni, emafidini namafidi wokuhlola wase-US kuphela.
crs.p.units.m: Iphrojekthi isemamitheni kodwa lolu hlelo lusemafidini. Shintsha kuqala iyunithi yephrojekthi, noma khetha uhlelo olusemamitheni.
crs.p.units.ft: Iphrojekthi isemafidini kodwa lolu hlelo lusemamitheni. Shintsha kuqala iyunithi yephrojekthi, noma khetha uhlelo olusemafidini.
set.order.hint: Iphoyinti, inyakatho, i-easting, ukuphakama, incazelo — noma i-easting ngaphambi kwenyakatho. Isetshenziselwa amaphoyinti okopishayo (imigqa efakwa kuspredshithi), imigqa yamaphoyinti oyinamathisela, nokubhekwa kokungenisa uma ifayela lingenayo imigqa yekhanda.
set.renum.hint: Gcina izinombolo ezikhululekile: iphoyinti elinamathiselwe ligcina inombolo yalo uma kungekho phoyinti elilayo, kuphela amaphoyinti ahlangene ashintshelwa izinombolo. Amaphoyinti amabili ngeke ahlale enombolo efanayo. Shiya okokuqala kungenalutho ukuze kubalwe kusuka enombolweni ephezulu esetshenziswayo; uma kukhona okokuqala, izinombolo ezintsha ziyakhula kusuka lapho, zidlule ezisevele zithathiwe.
set.labels.hint: Okubonisa ilebula yephoyinti uma i-Amalebula amaphoyinti ivulekile ngaphansi kwe-Display. Ukuthumela nge-DXF, nge-DWG nge-PDF kubonisa okufanayo.
set.corner.hint: Ikhyubhu lokubuka lisesikhonini esiphezulu esingakwesokudla semephu nasekubukweni kwe-3D. Emephini likhombisa phezulu; chofoza noma iyiphi enye inhlangothi, umphetho noma isikhonini, noma uwudonse, ukuze ubone isayithi nge-3D ukusuka lapho. Ku-3D, chofoza ukuze ubuke ohlangothini, udonse ukuze uzungeze, udonse indilinga yekhampasi ukuze uphendule. Isithonjana se-axis ngumphawu omncane we-X, Y (nowe-Z ku-3D) ngakwesokunxele esiphansi.
set.exag.hint: Ukuthi ukubuka kwe-3D kwelula okuphakama kangakanani. Uhlu oluku-bha yokubuka kwe-3D yisethingi efanayo. Amavolumu, amaphrofayili nokuthunyelwa kwe-3D kuhlala ngesikali sangempela.
set.latlon.hint: Indlela ibha yesimo ebonisa ngayo ububanzi nobude besikhombi: amadigri, amaminithi namasekhondi, noma amadigri ayizingxenye ezidecimal. Ibonisa kuphela uma iphrojekthi inohlelo lwamakhoordinethi (GIS › Coordinates).
set.internet.hint: Uma kuvulekile, i-CivilCraft icela amaseva emephu owengezayo izithombe zendawo ebonakala esikrinini. Umdwebo wakho uhlala kulo kompyutha; iseva ibona indawo nekheli lakho le-inthanethi. Uma kuvaliwe, akukho seva yemephu ecelwa lutho; ifayela lesithombe elinamakhoordinethi lisebenza nokho.
crs.shift.nad83: I-NAD83 ithathwa njenge-WGS 84. Zihluka ngamamitha ambalwa noma amabili endaweni eningi, namamitha ambalwa kakhulu okungenani.
crs.shift.prj: Kufundwe kufayela le-.prj: ukushintshwa kuya ku-WGS 84 yilokho okushiwo yifayela, uma kukhona; izingqimba zemephu ne-GeoJSON kungase kube ngamamitha amakhulu uma lingashiwo lutho.
crs.shift.unknown: Ukushintshwa kuya ku-WGS 84 kwale datum akwaziwa; izingqimba zemephu ne-GeoJSON kungase kube ngamamitha amakhulu.
crs.shift.known: Ukushintshwa kuya ku-WGS 84 kwaziwa cishe ku-{acc} (inani le-EPSG).
crs.local.ground: Umhlaba: grid = isisekelo + {scale} × (iphrojekthi − isisekelo), isisekelo E {e}, N {n}.
crs.reproject.tin: Umphezulu uvela kufayela le-LandXML njengamatrayangula, futhi lawa awakwazi ukuguqulwa lapha. Sebenzisa “Akha kabusha umphezulu kusuka emaphoyinteni” kuqala, noma guqula ifayela ngaphambi kokulivula.

mapl.off.body: Uma kuvulekile, i-CivilCraft icela amaseva emephu owengezayo izithombe zendawo ebonakala esikrinini. Umdwebo wakho uhlala kulo kompyutha; iseva ibona indawo nekheli lakho le-inthanethi. Izingqimba ze-inthanethi zidwetshwe ngezansi kodwa azidwetshwa; isithombe esivela kufayela sisebenza nokho.
mapl.no_crs: Iphrojekthi ayinalo uhlelo lwamakhoordinethi, ngakho izingqimba zemephu azikwazi ukubekwa. Lisethe ngaphansi kwe-GIS › Coordinates. Isithombe esinefayela lomhlaba elisebenzisa amakhoordinethi ephrojekthi lisebenza ngaphandle kwalo.

mapl.files.help: Khetha isithombe nefayela laso lomhlaba (.pgw ye-PNG, .jgw ye-JPEG, noma .wld) kanye ne-.prj yaso, uma ikhona. I-GeoTIFF ye-RGB iqukethe indawo yayo. Isithombe sigcinwa kufayela lephrojekthi (kuze kube ngu-25 MB). Ungaphinde ushiye amafayela emephini.
mapl.help.xyz: Ikheli le-tile linama-{{z}}, {{x}} no-{{y}} (noma {{-y}}) lapho kuya khona i-zoom, ikholomu nomugqa; {{s}} ikhetha inhlamvu yeseva. Ama-tile asemephini ye-web Mercator futhi aguqulelwa kuhlelo lwephrojekthi.
mapl.help.wms: Ikheli le-WMS (nesixhumanisi se-GetCapabilities nalo liyasebenza). I-CivilCraft icela izingqimba zeseva, bese kuthi isithombe esisodwa sendawo ebonakala esikrinini kuhlelo lwephrojekthi ngekhodi ye-EPSG uma iseva inikeza lokho, kungenjalo ku-web Mercator noma WGS 84 (oguqulwe).
mapl.help.wmts: Ikheli le-WMTS, noma i-WMTSCapabilities.xml yalo. I-CivilCraft isebenzisa isethi yamamatrikisi ama-tile esohlelweni lwephrojekthi uma likhona, kungenjalo i-web Mercator (oguqulwe).
mapl.help.arcgis: Isevisi yemephu noma yesithombe ye-ArcGIS: ikheli liphela nge-/MapServer noma /ImageServer. Amasevisi agciwe ku-web Mercator adwetshwa ngama-tile awo; ezinye zicelwa isithombe esisodwa sendawo ebonakala esikrinini.

crs.d.grid.note: Izixhumanisi zephrojekthi ngamakhodinethi egridi ohlelo lwawo (state plane, UTM…). Iningi lamaphrojekthi lidwetshwa ngale ndlela.
crs.d.ground.note: Izixhumanisi zomhlaba: amabanga ephuleni ayizinkomba zangempela emhlabeni. Igridi = isisekelo + inani elihlanganisiwe × (umhlaba − isisekelo).
crs.d.base.note: Iphoyinti lesisekelo yindawo lapho izixhumanisi zomhlaba nezegridi zifana khona. Iningi lezifunda lilinganisa cishe ku-0,0, ngakho izixhumanisi zomhlaba zisondela kakhulu kwezegridi; ezinye zisebenzisa iphoyinti lokulawula lephrojekthi — sebenzisa lokho isilinganiso sisho.
crs.d.factor.head: Bala inani ephoyinti
crs.d.local.note: Igridi yendawo ecatshangwayo (5000, 5000 …) ebotshelelwe kuhlelo ngamaphoyinti okulawula amabili: khetha iphoyinti ngalinye lokuhlola (thayipha inombolo yalo noma uchofoze ephuleni), bese uthayipha izixhumanisi zalo zegridi — noma i-latitude nelongitude yalo.

san.lead: Ukugeleza okuphezulu kwendle yezinkavu: abantu nendawo engena endaweni ngayinye yesakhiwo, kufakwe kube yinani, kuphindwe ngesivinini esilingene nomuntu nomlinganiselo wokuphakama, kwengezwe ukungena kwamanzi. Ukugeleza okuphezulu okuzinzile kuphela; akukho ukuhamba ngesikhathi.
san.note: P ibhekisela kubantu ngezinkulungwane. Lezi zinani zokuqala ziyizibambi, hhayi isilinganiso esisemthethweni: setha ezakho ezikhungweni zakho. Amasivinini asendaweni yokuphakama kokugeleza okuphezulu (Manning, n ongaguquki).
san.none: Azikho izinkavu okwamanje: khetha isakhiwo bese ufaka abantu nendawo engena khona.
san.size.note: Ukulinganisa amapayipi ngalezi zinkavu kukhetha, ngephayipi ngalinye, usayizi omncane kakhulu osemthethweni okwazi ukuthwala ukugeleza kwawo okuphezulu ngokugcwala okuphezulu okungenhla, ngokuthambeka kwephayipi lawo.
san.s.note: Ngezitolo, ezehhovisi noma embonini, faka abantu abalingene (indawo × abantu ngendawo ejwayelekile). Indawo ibalwa ekungeneni kwamanzi.
san.head: Ukugeleza kwezinkavu zokuklama
san.ok: Yonke iphayipi ithwala ukugeleza kwayo okuphezulu ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo.

as.head: Ukwakheka
as.on: Yakha uhlangothi ngalunye ngezingxenye (umphetho, umfudlana, indlela yabahambi phansi …)
as.off.note: Manje zombili izinhlangothi ziyilane elilodwa nesiyingi esisodwa. Vula lokhu ukuze uhlangothi ngalunye lube nohlu lwezingxenye zalo, oluqale kulilane nakwesiyingi elifanayo.
as.note: Izingxenye zihamba kusuka emgqeni oyinhloko ziye ngaphandle. Ukuthambeka okuya ngaphandle kuwukwehla kusuka emgwaqweni, ngakho indlela yabahambi phansi ehlela emgwaqweni inegatsha elingaphansi kwe-zero. Ukugoqa kwenza wonke ilane esikhundleni sokuqala; umfudlana, umphetho, ibhande nendlela yabahambi phansi kuncika emaphethelweni amalane njengoba akhiwe. Uhlangothi olungenayo ingxenye ethi "Ubuthambeka emhlabeni" lusebenzisa izilinganiso zokusika nokugcwalisa zokwakheka okulula.

ifc.summary: Efayeleni, endaweni eyodwa: ukuhlelwa {al}, ama-corridor {roads}, izindawo {surf}, amapheya {pads}, izindonga zokugcina {walls}, amapayipi {pipes}, izakhiwo {structs}, izigaba zomhlaba {parcels}, izinto zezitshalo {ls}, izinqwaba zezakhiwo {masses}.
ifc.loss.43.cant: Ukuphakanyiswa kwegwaqo akubona i-cant (leyo yesakhiwo sesitimela): kubhalwa njengezenzakalo ze-superelevation ekuhlelweni nasemathambekeni ahlangene wezindawo zegwaqo. Izitimela zithola i-IfcAlignmentCant.
ifc.loss.43.thick: Izingxenye zomgwaqo ziyizindawo ezivela ezigabeni ze-corridor, ngaphandle kobukhulu bomgangatho (i-CivilCraft ayikabi namagangatho omgwaqo okwamanje).
ifc.loss.4.align: Azikho izinto zokuhlelwa: ukuhlelwa kuwumugqa we-3D. Ama-PI nama-PVI awo agcinwa kusethi yezici, ngakho i-CivilCraft iyawufunda ngokunembile; ezinye izinhlelo zibona umugqa.
ifc.loss.4.road: Azikho izigaba zomgwaqo, ukugqoka, umphetho noma imisebenzi yomhlaba: lezi yizinto zomsebenzi ezibizwa ngokuthi zinjani, zihlelwe ngomgwaqo ngamunye.
ifc.loss.2.proxy: Azikho izigaba zomsebenzi nezendawo: izingxenye zomgwaqo, izindawo, imisebenzi yomhlaba, izigaba nokuhlelwa kuyizinto zesakhiwo ezibizwa ngokuthi zinjani; amapayipi ayizigaba zokugeleza.
ifc.loss.2.geo: Azikho into yokuguqula imephu: uhlelo lokuxhumanisa nomthombo kufakwa kuma-ePSet_ProjectedCRS ne-ePSet_MapConversion ezisetini zendawo.
ifc.loss.2.mesh: Izindawo zibhalwa ubuso nobuso, ngakho ifayela likhulu kakhulu kangaka.
ifc.nocrs: Iprojekthi ayinaluhlelo lokuxhumanisa, ngakho ifayela alibekwanga emephini: ligcina umthombo wendawo kusethi yezici. Setha olunye ngaphansi kwe-GIS › Ukuxhumanisa uqala uma umamukeli edinga izixhumanisi zemephu.

rail.head: Isitimela
rail.off.note: Vula lokhu ukuze uthole izinguquko zesitimela, ukuphambeka emajikeni, ithrekhi (igeji, amarele, izigxobo, ibhalasti) nezinani zethrekhi.
rail.note: Yonke inani lapha yisibambi okufanele ushintshwe ngesilinganiso sesitimela sakho; akukho ithebula kazwelonke elakhelwe ngaphakathi.
rail.speed.none.short: Akukakho okwamanje: setha isivinini sokuklama ngenhla
rail.undo.speed: Shintsha isivinini sezitimela ezihamba kancane kakhulu
rail.curves.note: Ubude bokuguquka yizinde zesipiralini kuthebhuli ye-PI. Ukuphambeka okulinganayo = G·v² / (g·R) ne-G = {base} mm phakathi kwemiphakathi yamarele; ukuntuleka = okulinganayo − okusetshenzisiwe ngesivinini somugqa, ukweqisa = okusetshenzisiwe − okulinganayo ngesivinini sezitimela ezihamba kancane kakhulu. Ukuphambeka kwenyuka ngaphezu kwayo yonke inguquko (kuqondile ku-clothoid noma iparabola ye-cubic, ngesimo se-Bloss ku-Bloss); uhlangothi lwejika olungenayo inguquko lunyuka emgqeni oqondile.
rail.nocurves: Awukho amajika okwamanje: nika i-PI iradiyasi.
rail.limits.note: Izibambi: izitimela zisetha lezi ngokwesivinini nohlobo lwethrekhi. Inani elidlula umkhawulo liba yisexwayiso kuphaneli Yezinkinga.
rail.diagram.label: Ukuphakama kwerele ngalinye ngaphezu kwephrofayili kuma-station: irele lesobunxele liqinile, irele lesokudla lidashiwe, ukuphambeka okusetshenzisiwe kuyidotiwe
rail.build.note: Yakha ithrekhi njengekhoridoro lalo mzila ngokuphrofayili wawo wokuklama (phezulu kwerele), ilinganiswe emhlabeni.
rail.built.noprofile: Ithrekhi ivuliwe. Dweba iphrofayili yokuklama (phezulu kwerele) ukuze uyibone yakhiwe.
rail.qty.note: Amavolumu ngezindawo zokuphela ezilinganayo phakathi kwezigaba zekhoridoro; amarele nezigxobo ngomugqa wethrekhi ngayinye.
rail.qty.none: Akukho nani okwamanje: ithrekhi idinga iphrofayili yokuklama nomhlaba (noma isimeleli esiyisicaba).
rail.co.note: Leli khoridoro liyithrekhi yesitimela: isigaba salo sivela kumasethingi Esitimela ngenhla (akukho mabhande, ukuphakama kohlangothi noma izinhloso).

sx.su957.ed.title: Isigaba esiteshini somfula {rs}
sx.su957.ed.lede: Hudula izibambi ku-plot, noma uthayipe izinombolo. Amabhange ahlukanisa isigaba sibe ingaphezu kwebhange lesokunxele, umsele oyinhloko nengaphezu kwebhange lesokudla. Umphethe usika umhlaba ongaphesheya kwawo kuze kube amanzi asezansi kwesiphezulu sawo. Indawo engasebenzi ibamba amanzi kodwa ayiphathi ukugeleza.
sx.su957.ed.aria: Umhlaba wesigaba onamabhange, imiphethe nezindawo ezingasebenzi ezidonsekayo
sx.su957.ed.note: Imiphethe nezindawo ezingasebenzi zishiya indawo, umjikelezo onamanzi nokudluliswa kwalowo mkhakha. Indawo yesikhukhula igcina umhlaba ngemuva komphethe uomile ngenkathi amanzi esezansi kwesiphezulu. Isisetshenziswa sokuklama; umjwayeli uyahlola umphumela.
sx.su957.ed.bad: Amabhange kumele abe phakathi kwesigaba, nelesokunxele kumele libe ngakwesokunxele kwelesokudla.

geo.lead.borings: Bhala ungqimba ngalunye lwelogi yokubhoboza: ukujula kusuka kuya, iqembu lenhlabathi (USCS) nokwaziwayo ngamandla ayo. Amanani okuqala ajwayelekile, akalinganiswanga: wawashintshe ngokuhlolwa kwakho.
geo.lead.sections: Umugqa odwetshwe emaphethelweni okubhoboza: iprofayili yenhlabathi nokuthambeka kusikwa ngawo.
geo.lead.slopes: Ukuzinza kokuthambeka ngaphansi kwesigaba ngokumelene nokushelela kwesiyingi (Bishop elula), kufunwa isiyingi esibalulekile emhlabeni okhona.
geo.lead.settles: Ukuntuleka kokulayisha okunxantathu kubhoboza: ukuqina kobumba, ukuntuleka okusheshayo kanye nesikhathi esithathayo.
geo.lead.junctions: Imilenze ehlangana endaweni eyodwa, namaphethelo ogwini, ukubona kude ngesivinini somklamo kanye nezindawo zokubona. Akukho ukuhlelwa kwesignali.
geo.lead.stripes: Imigqa ependwe nezimpawu ngomugqa wendlela, namagebe ezixhumaneni. Ububanzi, izibhobo nosayizi wezimpawu kuyizibambi: umhlahlandlela womphathi wakho yiwo ophethe.
geo.lead.nets: Amaphoyinti abanjwe eqinile noma akhululekile nokulinganisa phakathi kwawo. Ukulungisa kuthola ama-coordinate anokwenzeka kakhulu, kubhekise amaphutha nokudweba ama-ellipse amaphutha. Ngenisa ifayela lasensimini ukuze uqale kulo.
geo.lead.pits: Izampuli zokubhoboza ziba yimodeli yamabhlogo; igodi lokugcina iwuhlu olubaluleke kakhulu lwamabhlogo angakhiwa ngaphakathi kwe-engeli yokuthambeka.
geo.lead.links: Ama-antenna amabili phezu komhlaba okhona: ingabe indlela icacile, kusalele kangakanani umkhawulo, nokuthi yimast yini ezoyisusa.
geo.lead.turnouts: Iswichi ngenombolo yalo ye-frog, noma ukuhlangana phakathi kwamagceke afanayo. Yonke imikhawulo yimigomo yomgwaqo wesitimela; umdwebo womkhiqizi ubusa iswichi eyakhiwe.

sx.su957.issue.structreach: Ukwelula ngakunye phakathi kwezakhiwo kudinga izigaba ezimbili okungenani.
river.un.title: Ukugeleza okungazinzile: {name}
river.un.intro: Dlulisa i-hydrograph yesikhukhula kule mfula. Iqala kumphezulu wamanzi ozinzile ekugeleni kokuqala. Ukugeleza okungaphansi kwe-critical, indawo eyodwa, akukho zinduku noma mabhuloho ngaphakathi kokusebenza, akukho ukungena okuvela ngasohlangothini.
river.un.hydro.hint: Iphere eyodwa ngomugqa ngamunye: isikhathi ngamahora, ikhoma, ukugeleza. Ukugeleza kuqonde phakathi kwemigqa.
river.un.review: Usizo lokuklama kuphela: lemiphumela idinga ukubuyekezwa unjiniyela ogunyaziwe ngaphambi kokuthi kukhona ocela ukuncika kuwo.
river.un.mass: Ivolumu ingena {vin}, iphuma {vout}, ushintsho olugcinwe {ds}; umehluko: {err} % wesikhulu kunazo zonke. Izinyathelo zesikhathi {steps}.
river.un.plot.aria: Ukugeleza ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ezinhlangothini zangaphezulu nezangaphansi
river.un.issue.noinflow: Bhala okungenani imigqa emibili ye-hydrograph: amahora, ikhoma, ukugeleza.
river.un.issue.badtime: Isikhathi esiphelele nesinyathelo sesikhathi kumele sibe ngaphezu kwe-zero.
river.un.issue.nodown: Ukuthambeka kwasezansi komfula kumele kube ngaphezu kwe-zero.
river.un.issue.badtheta: Isisindo sesikhathi kumele sibe ngaphezu kuka-0.5 futhi sibe ngaphansi noma silingane no-1.
river.un.issue.toobig: Ukusebenza kukhulu kakhulu: sebenzisa isinyathelo sesikhathi eside noma izigaba ezimbalwa.
river.un.issue.structures: Izigxobo nemabhuloho akuyona ingxenye yokusebenza okungazinzile; amanzi ageleza ngezigaba ezivulekile.
river.un.issue.nostart: Ukuqala okuzinzile akukwazanga ukuxazululwa: qala ngeprofayili ezinzile kuqala bese ulungisa lokho okubikwa yiyo.
river.un.flag.walls: Amanzi akhuphuke ngaphezu kwezinhlangothi zesigaba futhi amiswa yizindonga lapho.
river.un.flag.froude: Ukugeleza kushintshe kwaba ngaphezu kwesivinini esibucayi endaweni thile: le ndlela yokubala ilungele ukugeleza okuncane, ngakho ungazethembi lezo zigaba.
river.un.flag.noconv: Isinyathelo sesikhathi asihlangani futhi ukusebenza kumisiwe: sebenzisa isinyathelo sesikhathi esincane.
river.st.prob.overtop: {name} ku-station {rs}: amanzi adlula endleleni noma edekhini ekugelezeni: {q}.
river.st.prob.fast: {name} ku-station {rs}: ukugeleza okusheshayo ngaphakathi kwesigxobo; hlola ukukhukhula ngaphansi endaweni yokuphuma.
river.st.prob.choked: {name} ku-station {rs}: ivulo livimbela ukugeleza futhi lisundulela amanzi emuva.
river.st.prob.pressure: {name} ku-station {rs}: amanzi aphezu kwe-low chord (ukugeleza ngoxinzelelo).
bundle.nomodel: "{file}" yiphakethe loqobo elingenamodeli engavulwa yalolu hlelo. BimCraft ivula iphrojekthi yonke.
crs.pick.name: Iprojekthi yezifiso
crs.pick.long: Leyo ncazelo inde kakhulu ukuba yiprojekthi.
crs.pick.bad: Iprojekthi ayikwazanga ukwakhiwa kuleyo ncazelo. Hlola igama +proj= nezici zayo.
crs.pick.unit: Iyunithi kumele ibe yimitha, amafidi noma amafidi wesivivinyo saseMelika (+units=m, ft noma us-ft, noma +to_meter=).
crs.pick.use: Leyo ncazelo iyakwazi ukwakha, kodwa ayiguquli ubude nobubanzi babe izixhumanisi zemephu futhi ibuyele emuva, ngakho ayikwazi ukusetshenziswa.
crs.pick.matched: Lokhu kunikeza izixhumanisi ezifanayo ne-EPSG:{code}, {name}: leyo khodi iyasetshenziswa.
crs.pick.nocode: Akukho i-EPSG:{code} kuhlu. Sesha ngegama, noma unamathisele incazelo.
geo.pick.name: Igama
geo.pick.hits.more: Izinhlelo zokuqala: {n}. Engeza amagama ukuze uncishise.
geo.pick.mine.none: Akukho okwamanje. Incazelo oyinamathisela noma ifayela .prj oyilayishile ingagcinelwa lapha.
geo.pick.share.note: Amaprojekthi ami agcinwa kuleli bhrawuzi futhi afana kuzo zonke izinhlelo ze-CadCraft ezinikeza lo khulumo.
geo.pick.share.geographic: Uhlelo lobude nobubanzi alusetshenziswa lapha. Khetha uhlelo lweprojekthi (UTM, state plane, igridi kazwelonke noma eyakho).
crs.d.more.title: Khetha uhlelo lwezixhumanisi lweprojekthi
crs.d.more.intro: Sesha ngenombolo ye-EPSG, ngesifunda se-UTM (UTM 33N) noma ngamagama asegameni, unamathisele incazelo yeprojekthi, layisha ifayela .prj, noma khetha eyakho.
crs.d.more.help: Bhala isifunda se-UTM noma inombolo ye-EPSG, unamathisele eyakho yeprojekthi, noma thatha enye ku-Amaprojekthi ami. Ukukhetha kuhlolwa ngeyunithi zeprojekthi ngaphambi kokusetshenziswa.
geo.pit.road.note: Lo mbhoshongo ngumdwebo obekwe ezindongeni ezinezitebhisi zemodeli yebhulokhi, ngokubeka nobubanzi obusethiwe. Akuyona idizayini yomzila wokuthutha: unjiniyela wezimayini uhlela owangempela.
geo.prob.pit-ramp-wraps: {item}: ombhoshongo mude kunodonga lwebhentshi, ngakho umzila kuzodingeka uzungeze umgodi ngaphezu kwesisodwa. Sebenzisa ukuthambeka okuqinile noma umgodi omkhulu.
geo.prob.pit-ramp-ring-narrow: {item}: umkhawulo phakathi kwebhentshi nelilandelayo ngaphansi ubhekile kunombhoshongo, ngakho umzila ungaphezu kwebhentshi elingaphansi. Sebenzisa ombhoshongo omncane noma udonga oluthambile.
geo.prob.pit-top-belowground: {item}: umhlaba emgodini ungaphezulu kwaphezulu kwemodeli yebhulokhi, ngakho izindonga ezingaphezu kwemodeli azikho. Phakamisa imodeli noma engeza ungqimba.
geo.f.leg-i: Isigaba se-I somlenze, cm⁴ (0 = yeqa ukugoba)
geo.cover.covered: Indawo enamandla okuzwa alingana noma aphezu kokuzwa kwesamukeli
geo.cover.note: Umdwebo wokuhlela: ukulahleka kwesikhala okuvulekile kanye nentaba embi kakhulu kwendlela ngayinye eqondile (knife edge, ITU-R P.526). Ayibandakanyi izintaba eziningi ngokulandelana, imvula, izihlahla ongazingenanga nemifanekiso yama-antenna, ngakho ibukeka ithemba kancane. Okuluhlaza kungu-20 dB noma ngaphezulu kokuzwa, okuphuzi kusuka ku-10 kuya ku-20, okuwolintshi kuze kufike ku-10.
geo.prob.tel-cover-fine: {item}: amaseli amancane kakhulu kulo msakazo ({cells} amaseli). Sebenzisa usayizi weseli omkhulu.
geo.prob.tel-cover-noground: {item}: isiphaphazeli asiphezu komhlaba owaziwayo, ngakho akukho okubaliwe.
geo.prob.tel-leg-over: {item}: umlenze wetawa uthwala: {util} % wamandla onikeze (ngesici sakho somthwalo). Lokhu kuwukuma kwezakhiwo kuphela: ikhodi yakho yetawa iyanquma.
geo.prob.tel-leg-buckling: {item}: umthwalo womlenze: {util} % womthwalo wokugoba kwe-Euler. Bopha kuseduze noma sebenzisa isigaba esikhulu.
geo.lead.covers: Lapho isiphaphazeli singezwakala phezu komhlaba okhona: amandla esignali esamukelwe iseli ngeseli, ashadiwe emdwebeni.
river.join.head: Ukuhlangana
river.join.note: Uma lo mfula ugeleza kwelinye, lezi zombili zixazululwa ndawonye: izikhwishi ziyengezelelwa, futhi lo mfula uphela ngaphezulu kwamanzi omfula ojoyinwayo. Umfula ojoyinwayo uthwala isamba semifula egeleza kuwo, ngakho ukuze ujoyine umfula omkhulu nomfula omncane, dweba umfula omfushane ngaphansi kwendawo yokuhlangana bese uvumela womabili ugeleze kuwo.
river.join.method: Indlela yendawo yamanzi elinganayo: imifula ehlanganayo iphela ezingeni lamanzi esigabeni sokuqala somfula omkhulu. Ayibandakanyi i-engile phakathi kwawo kanye nomfutho wezikhwishi, ngakho iyafaneleka emanzini ahamba kancane najulile futhi ayiqinile lapho ukugeleza kusheshayo. Ngokuzenzakalelayo okufanayo kwezinye: kudinga ukubuyekezwa yinjiniyela.
river.join.issue.profilecount: Imifula ehlanganayo kumele ibe nenani elifanayo lamaphrofayili okugeleza (iphrofayili 1 ngayinye iyisenzakalo esifanayo). Lungisa {id}.
river.join.issue.oneoutlet: Imifula ehlanganisiwe kumele iphele kumlomo wokuphuma owodwa kuphela.
sx.su957.defaults: Izinsuku ezizenzakalelayo kulemiphumela, zigcinwe kuze kubuyekezwe yinjiniyela: ukuncipha 0.1 nokwanda 0.3; umfudlana njengesiqephu esisodwa nokuqina okuhlanganisiwe; uhlobo oluxubile olukhethwe ngamandla athile okucindezela ngaphandle kokubeka ukugxuma; indawo yokukhukhula ifaka phakathi umhlaba ophansi ongaphakathi kwendlela yomfula ongafinyelelwa amanzi umaungadwebanga isivimbi. Shintsha noma yiziphi zalezi kuMpahla yomfula.
rail.std.note: Khetha umgomo ojwayelekile lezi zimingco zawo. Akukho nombolo evela kunoma yimuphi umgomo ofakiwe: wena (noma unjiniyela wesitimela) ufaka inani ngalinye, nesigatshana esivela kuso eduze kwalo.
rail.std.placeholder: Yonke inombolo kulelifasitela, ezinqamulelini nasegejini lesakhiwo isasebenza njengezibambi-ndawo, noma yimuphi umgomo ochazwe. Unjiniyela wesitimela uhlola inani ngalinye ngombhalo womgomo ngaphambi kokwakha noma yini.
pl.don.readuntested: Akuhlolwanga: umfundi wakhiwe kuhlu lwamagama wezindawo, hhayi kwifayela lokutadisha langempela. Hlola isekelo ngasinye ngefayela lakho.
geo.import.untested: Akuhlolwanga emafayeleni angempela: abafundi be-RW5, GSI, JobXML ne-CSV babhalwa ngencazelo yomphakathi yefomethi ngayinye futhi bazanywa kuphela emafayeleni esiwenzile. Hlola amaphoyinti nezinhlolo ngombiko wesisetshenziswa sakho.
eg.st.ctx.none: Akukho umkhawulo wesakhiwo, wepaseli, wokuhlelwa kwezindawo, wesikhukhula noma wenhlabathi ezingqimbeni ukuze uthunyelwe.
eg.st.ctx.saved: Imikhawulo igciniwe: {n}. Vula ifayela ku-BimCraft noma ku-ModelCraft ukuze uyibone njengezincomo.
eg.st.ctx.sent: Imikhawulo: {n}. Ithunyelwe njengezincomo kwelithi {app} ethebhini elisha. Akukho okulayishwa; ibonisa okuzothi uzamukele.
eg.st.ctx.blocked: Ibhrawuzi livimbe ithebhu elisha. Vumela ama-pop-up kule sayithi bese uzama futhi, noma gcina ifayela.
eg.st.ctx.failed: Kwehlulekile ukudlulisa lesi sayithi. Gcina ifayela esikhundleni salokho.
eg.st.ctx.note: Ifayela libamba imikhawulo ngamamitha empumalanga nasenyakatho yephoyinti lekheli, ngezindawo zezakhiwo ezinikezwe imithombo (amazinga abalwa njengo-3 m ngayinye futhi ayatshelwa). Enye i-app iyibonisa njengezincomo: akukho okwengezwa uze wamukele.
eg.st.keep.done: Ifayela manje ligcina isayithi. Imikhawulo: {n}; imithombo: {s}; ilandiwe: {day}. Gcina iphrojekthi ukuze ubhale. Akukho okulandwa futhi uma livuliwe.
eg.st.keep.none: Akukho okungagcinwa okwamanje: engeza impendulo yomthombo noma ifayela kuqala.
eg.st.kept.lead: Ikheli: {address}. Iphoyinti {lat}, {lon}, {radius} m kulo. Imikhawulo: {n}; impendulo zomuntu ngamunye: {i}; ilandiwe: {day}. Ukuvula ifayela kubonisa lokhu futhi ngaphandle kokucela noma iyiphi insiza.
scanin.cmd.title: Letha ishidi ngokusuka kusiskena, esithombeni noma kwi-PDF (ipulani yomhlaba, ukuhlola, ipulani yokuhlaza noma isikethi), limise ngesikali noma ngezixhumanisi ezaziwayo bese ulishintsha libe umdwebo
scanin.title: Qala kusikena: {file}
scanin.lede: Ishidi lihamba ngaphansi kwephulani njengesithombe, ngesikali noma ngezixhumanisi ozaziyo, nemigqa yalo ingalandelwa ibe ungqimba ongalushintsha ube umngcele noma imigqa yokwehlisa. Ifundwa kulo kompyutha; akukho okulayishwa.
scanin.straight.weak: (ishidi lingase libe: {deg}° lingekho nxande; imigqa yayincane kakhulu ukuze siqiniseke)
scanin.view.label: Ishidi. Vilapha ukuze usondeze, donsa ukuze uhambise, chofoza ukuze umaka iphoyinti.
scanin.place.head: Lapho iya khona
scanin.help.two: Chofoza kozombili amagalelo esinto obude bayo obaziwayo (ingxenye nobude, isilinganiso, ibha yesikali), bese ubhala lobo bude.
scanin.help.stated: Sebenzisa isikali esiphrintiwe kushidi. Lokhu kulungile kuphela uma ukuskena kwenziwe ngosayizi wangempela ngamachibi ahlinzekwe: hlola ubude obaziwayo ngemva kwalokho.
scanin.help.pts: Chofoza iphoyinti kushidi (ikhona lomhlaba, isiphawu, ukuhlangana kwegridi), bese ubhala i-easting ne-northing yalo noma inombolo yephoyinti lesamukelo elisevele kuphrojekthi. Amaphoyinti amabili amisa, aphendule futhi alinganise ishidi; eyesithathu ihlola abanye.
scanin.pts.stretch: Vumela ishidi lelule ngokwahlukile kuya kohlangothi nasezansi (iphepha elihlehle noma iskena esihudulile; kudinga amaphoyinti amathathu)
scanin.need.dist: Bhala ubude bangempela phakathi kwamaphoyinti amabili ({unit}).
scanin.need.stated: Nikeza i-dpi ishidi elaskenwa ngayo nesikali salo esiphrintiwe.
scanin.need.pts2: Maka okungenani amaphoyinti amabili futhi unikeze ngayinye izixhumanisi zayo noma iphoyinti lesamukelo.
scanin.need.pts3: Maka okungenani amaphoyinti amathathu (angewona umugqa owodwa) ukuvumela ishidi lelule.
scanin.need.spread: Amaphoyinti ahlangene endaweni eyodwa noma emugqeni owodwa: wahlakaze kushidi lonke.
scanin.then.head: Bese
scanin.trace: Yiguqule ibe umdwebo (imigqa nezingxenye zayo ngengqimba yayo)
scanin.trace.note: Imibhalo nokushaywa kwemigqa kuhlala esithombeni. Umdwebo uwumqalo, hhayi ukuhlola: hlola ngoshidi. Ungaphinda uguqule kamuva ohlwini lwamaSkena.
scanin.trace.big: Ishidi likhulu kakhulu ukuze lilandelwe ngesikhathi esisodwa; libekwe ngaphandle kokulandelwa.
scanin.what.head: Okuzotholakala
scanin.what.rms: Amaphoyinti avumelana kuze kufike ku-{rms} {unit} (i-root mean square).
scanin.what.unchecked: Ngamaphoyinti adingekayo kuphela, akukho okuwahlolayo: engeza omunye ukuze ubone ukuthi avumelana kangakanani.
scanin.err.kind: {file} akusiyo i-PDF, i-TIFF, i-PNG noma i-JPEG.
scanin.err.pdf: {file} iyi-PDF, futhi amakhasi e-PDF awakwazi ukufundwa lapha.
scanin.done.traced: Iguqulwe ibe umdwebo: imigqa engu-{n} ku-ungqimba "{layer}". Sebenzisa ukuze ubhalo womhlaba wenze umngcele noma imigqa yokwehlisa kuwo. Gcina iskena njengereferensi noma susa kuhlu lwamaSkena.
scanin.why.compression: ukucindezelwa kwe-TIFF akufundwa (akucindezelwe, PackBits, LZW ne-Group 4 kuyafundwa)
scanin.drop.ask: {file} akunalo ifayela lomhlaba. Ayibeke njengeshidi eskeniwe?
scanin.what.which: Iphoyinti elilodwa elengeziwe liyotshela ukuthi yiliphi elikhubazekile, uma likhona.
cad.sv.head: Amazinga okuhlola nokuhlola
cad.sv.lede: Amazinga abhalwe njengombhalo eduze kwephoyinti, noma kusici sebhulokhi, akusiyo imigqa, ngakho awafundwa njengomugqa. Achaze njengamaphoyinti okuhlola, futhi hlola umdwebo ngaphambi kokwakha umhlaba kuwo.
cad.sv.take: Thatha amazinga njengamaphoyinti okuhlola: {n} ({text} kumbhalo, {attr} kumakhono webhulokhi)
cad.sv.none: Akukho mazinga abhalwe njengombhalo noma njengamakhono webhulokhi atholakele.
cad.sv.what: Amaphoyinti okuhlola: {n}, anamazinga avela kumbhalo nasezici.
cad.sv.check.head: Hlola ngaphambi kokusetshenziswa
cad.sv.check.clean: Akutholakalanga lutho: iyunithi, ibanga kusuka emsuka, izingxenye zomhlaba, amazinga namaphoyinti kubonakala kulungile.
cad.sv.added: Engeza amaphoyinti okuhlola: {n} kusuka kumazinga kufayela: {file}.
survey.p.units.none: Umdwebo awusho ukuthi yiyuniti yini; ufundwa njengeyuniti: {unit}. Hlola ibanga oliwaziyo.
survey.p.units.big: Idatha imele cishe: {km} km. Umdwebo ungase ube ngamamilimitha noma ngenye iyuniti kunaleyo ethi uyona.
survey.p.units.small: Idatha imele {m} m. Umdwebo ungase ube ngamamitha kodwa ufundwe njengamamilimitha, noma udwetshwe kancane kakhulu.
survey.p.origin.far: Idatha ikude cishe ngo-{km} km kusukela endaweni yeziro (isikhungo cishe: {x}, {y}). Ukude nezeru, imibono ye-3D ilahlekelwa ukunemba futhi iyazamazama.
survey.p.contours.flat: Ungqimba lwemigqa yamazinga {layer}: imigqa {flat} kwayo {all} ayinakho ukuphakama (ilingana ku-0). Umhlaba owakhiwe kuyo uzoba lingana.
survey.p.z.zero: Amazinga {n} angu-0 ngqo, kanti izinga elivamile linguthi: {median}. Angase abe ukuphakama okungekho.
survey.p.z.outlier: Amazinga {n} akude kakhulu nabanye (ivamile: {median}; kufanele abe phakathi kwezinombolo {low} no {high}).
survey.p.dup.same: Amaphoyinti {n} ahlezi phezu kwephoyinti elinye ezingeni elifanayo.
survey.p.dup.level: Amaphoyinti {n} ahlezi phezu kwephoyinti elinye elinezinga elihlukile.
scanin.src.title: Iskena
scanin.src.lede: Ishidi livela kuphi? Noma yini, liba iskena: libekwe ngaphansi kwepulani liguqulelwe umdwebo, bese liyagcinwa noma liyasuswa uma useqedile nalo.
scanin.src.noscanner: Ukuskena ngqo kusuka esiskeneni kudinga i-CadCraft Studio kukhompyutha. Lapha, skena kufolda noma kwi-imeyili kusikhopi bese ukhetha ifayela, noma thatha isithombe.
scanin.sc.found: Kutholakele {n}. Beka ishidi kuskena bese ucindezela Skena.
scanin.sc.none: Akukho skena oluphendulile kule unethiwekhi. Amaskena kanethiwekhi namakhophi asekela AirScan noma Mopria akhombeka lapha; uma kuyiskena esixhunywe nge-USB, skena ufake ifayela bese ukhetha ifayela.
scanin.sc.name: Skena {when}
scanin.sc.err.refused: {name} yenqabile ukuskena. Hlola ukuthi kukhona ishidi engilazini noma kusidluli.
scanin.sc.err.nopage: {name} ayithumelanga khasi. Hlola ukuthi kukhona ishidi engilazini noma kusidluli.
scanin.sc.err.network: Akukwazanga ukufinyelela {name}. Bheka futhi, noma hlola ukuthi ivuliwe futhi ikule unethiwekhi.
scanin.list.head: Amaskena
scanin.list.note: Iskena lihlala lapha kuze uthathe isinqumo: ligcine njengesethenjwa ngaphansi kwepulani, noma ulisuse uma umdwebo waso usenziwe. Umdwebo ungungqimba lwawo futhi uhlala noma kunjalo.
scanin.list.drawn: Iguqulelwe umdwebo (imigqa {n}). Gcina iskena njengesethenjwa, noma usisuse?
scanin.list.kept.drawn: Iguqulelwe (imigqa {n}) futhi ligcinwe njengesethenjwa ngaphansi kwepulani.

ls.pt.head: Ithebula lezitshalo (le phrojekthi)
ls.pt.lede: Umugqa ngamunye uyirekhodi lesitshalo kuhlu lwalo lwephrojekthi. Izilinganiso ezinikezwayo: eyodwa ngayinye, ihlukaniswe ngo-';', isb. "c10 container 10L h0.6; rb rootball h3 g14-16 st1.8" (i-id, uhlobo, bese i-volume L, h ukuphakama m, s ukusabalala m, g ukuzungeza cm, st isiqu esicacile m). Amahlobo: amagama ahlukaniswe ngo-';'. Ushintsho ngalunye luyisinyathelo esisodwa sokuhlehlisa.
ls.pt.json.done: Kulondoloze amarekhodi {n} njengefayela lezitshalo (inguqulo 2). Ungalivula kwenye iphrojekthi noma ulithumele kuMtapo.

ls.st.lede: Umhlaba okuhlongozwayo = umhlaba okhona + lezi, kulolu hlelo. Lapho ezimbili zihlanganyela, eyokugcina iyanqoba. Hudula umugqa noma sebenzisa imicibisholo ukuwuhlela kabusha. Umhlaba okhona awushintshwa ngalutho.

tpl.lib.blocked: Lesi siphequluli asivumeli i-CivilCraft ukugcina umtapo. Thumela amathempulethi njengefayela esikhundleni salokho.
tpl.mgr.title: Amathempulethi ekhoridoro
tpl.mgr.lede: Ithempulethi kuyinqamuleko emincane: amaphoyinti anokubekwa, amathambeka namakhodi wamaphoyinti, nezingxenye ezinezinto. Zisebenzise ekhoridoreni ngohla lwamasiteshi, uhlangothi lwesobunxele nolwesokudla lwahlukanisiwe, noma uzibeke emhlabeni.
tpl.mgr.project.none: Ayikho amathempulethi kule phrojekthi okwamanje. Sebenzisa isibonelo, eyodwa emtapweni wami, noma yenze entsha.
tpl.mgr.mine.note: Igcinwa kule siphequluli futhi iyatholakala kuyo yonke iphrojekthi. Thumela ifayela ukuze wabelane nabo noma uwahambise kukhompyutha enye.
tpl.mgr.mine.none: Akukho okusemtapweni wami okwamanje. Londoloza ithempulethi lapho kule phrojekthi.
tpl.mgr.examples.note: Izibonelo ziyizikhala zokuqala. Izinombolo zazo azithathwanga kunoma yisiphi isilinganiso noma inhlangano; injiniyela kumele ihlole yonke ithempulethi ngaphambi kokusetshenziswa kwemklamo.
tpl.ed.lede: Dweba uhlangothi lwesokudla, uphume kwiphoyinti le-0,0; uhlangothi lwesobunxele lusebenzisa lolo luphuma luya ngasekhohlo. Iphoyinti ngalinye libekwa kusuka kwiphoyinti elidlule ngokukhawulwa kwalo. Ibhokisi lenombolo lamukela inombolo noma igama lenani (nophawu '-' ukuze kube yinegethivu yalo), ngakho ithempulethi elilodwa lingasebenza ngobubanzi nangokujula okuningi.
tpl.ed.name: Igama
tpl.ed.drawnote: Idwetshwe ngesilinganiso sangempela. Umugqa oqinile uwubuso oqediwe; izingxenye ezinamachashaza zincike emhlabeni futhi ziboniswa njengokuqagela.
tpl.ed.params.note: Amanani abizwa ayasetshenziswa amaphoyinti. Ikhoridoro ngalinye lingasebenzisa amanani alo.
tpl.ed.points.note: Ngokulandelana. Phezulu = ebusweni obuqediwe; iphoyinti eliphezulu lokugcina lapho kuqala ithempulethi elilandelayo kuleli hlangothi. Injongo = ikhoridoro lingahambisa iphoyinti kumugqa.
tpl.ed.comps.note: Izimo ezivaliwe ngamakhodi wamaphoyinti (0 kuyiphoyinti lika-0,0), ngayinye inegama nezinto. Izindawo zazo zinikeza amavolumu.
tpl.ed.c.name: Igama lengxenye {n}
tpl.prob.empty: Isifanekiso asinalutho i-CivilCraft ingasisebenzisa: nikeza igama nephoyinti elilodwa noma ngaphezulu.
tpl.prob.notop: Akukho phoyinti phezu komphezulu osuqediwe: khetha i-Top ukuze uthole amaphoyinti okuhamba kuwo umphezulu womgwaqo.
tpl.prob.endnotlast: Iphoyinti {at} lihlangana nomhlaba kodwa alilona iphoyinti lokugcina eliphezulu; amaphoyinti alandelayo emphezulwini awasoze afinyelwe.
tpl.prob.endnoground: Isimo sokuphela kufanele siphele ngephoyinti elihlangana nomhlaba (ukuthambeka kohlangothi, emhlabeni noma kudonga).
tpl.prob.pavementends: Lesi sifanekiso sendlela siphela emhlabeni, ngakho akukho okungahlanganiswa ngemva kwaso. Yenze isimo sokuphela, noma uphele ngokuthambeka.
tpl.prob.terrainnocomp: Isifanekiso somhlaba sidinga okungenani ingxenye eyodwa: izingqimba esizihlanganisayo zivela kuzo.
tpl.prob.flatcomp: Ingxenye {at} ayinayo indawo: amaphoyinti ayo ayomugqa owodwa.
tpl.co.head: Izifanekiso ngesiteshi
tpl.co.off.note: Izifanekiso zithatha indawo yesakhiwo: uhla ngalunye lwesiteshi lunezifanekiso zalo, kwesobunxele nakwesokudla kwehlukaniswe, ngohlangothi ngalunye nesimo sokuphela salo.
tpl.co.pavement: Ukufakwa komgwaqo, kusuka emugqeni wephakathi kuya ngaphandle
tpl.co.end.none: Ukuhlangana nomhlaba ezindaweni zokusika nokugcwalisa zekhoridoro
tpl.co.note: Indawo ihamba kusuka esiteshini sayo kuye esiteshini sendawo elandelayo. Isifanekiso ngasinye ohlangothini siqala ephoyinteni eliphezulu lokugcina lesangaphambilini; isimo sokuphela sihlangana nomhlaba. Ibhokisi lenani elingenalutho lisebenzisa inani lesifanekiso ngokwaso.
tpl.co.mode.note: Ukuthambeka kohlangothi namasinjongo emaphethelweni ekhoridoro akusetshenziswa lapho ikhoridoro yakhiwe ngezifanekiso; sebenzisa kunalokho izinjongo zamaphoyinti ezifanekisweni.
tpl.q.note: Amavolumu ngezindawo eziphakathi zokuphela, alinganiswe emugqeni wephakathi.
tpl.corr.name: {corridor}: {name}
tpl.more.head: Amakhoridoro kulo mzila
tpl.more.none: Umzila omude ungahlukaniswa ube amakhoridoro amaningi, ngayinye ezindaweni zayo zesiteshi nezifanekiso zayo.
tpl.more.note: Ikhoridoro ngayinye inendawo yayo yesiteshi. Lapho izindawo ezimbili zihlanganayo, ikhoridoro elilandelayo lidlula phezu kwelandulelayo.

tpl.tt.head: Izifanekiso zomhlaba
tpl.tt.lede: Hlanganisa izingqimba zesifanekiso emhlabeni kusuka ephoyinteni lakhe 0,0: izingqimba ezingaphansi kwalo zingena emhlabeni (inhlabathi engaphezulu okufanele ikhishwe), izingqimba ezingaphezulu kwalo zihlala phezu komhlaba (ukufakwa nesisekelo kwepaki). Ububanzi nokuthambeka akubalulekile; isimo sendawo siyazinqamula.

tpl.tt.note: Indawo ilinganiswe kumaseli angu-{n} ka-{cell} {u}; indawo ethambekile ehlangene ingu-{sloped} {a}. Ivolumu = indawo ephelweni × ukujula, ukujula kulinganiswa ngqo ngaphansi.
tpl.tt.prob.noshape: Isimo sawo asisekho. Khetha esinye isimo.
tpl.tt.prob.noground: Akukho mhlaba okwamanje: yakha umphezulu kuqala.
tpl.mat.head: Izinto ezivela ezifanekisweni
tpl.mat.note: Kubekwa yizifanekiso zekhoridoro nezifanekiso zomhlaba. Lawa mavolumu aya efayelweni lenani le-TakeoffCraft.
tpl.qty.note: Kusuka ezifanekisweni zekhoridoro nezomhlaba ze-CivilCraft (amavolumu okumbiwa).
tpl.ex.lanes.name: Imigwaqo emibili nomphezulu nesisekelo
tpl.ex.lanes.note: Isibonelo: ilane enokuthambeka okuhlangene, nomphezulu wendlela nesisekelo ngaphansi kwawo. Amanani wesikhashana okufanele ahlolwe.
tpl.ex.curb.name: Isikhwele nomfudlana
tpl.ex.curb.note: Isibonelo: ipani lomfudlana elehla liye ebusweni besikhwele, siphezulu sesikhwele nomzimba wekhonkolo. Amanani wesikhashana okufanele ahlolwe.
tpl.ex.walk.name: Indlela yabahambi ngezinyawo
tpl.ex.walk.note: Isibonelo: indlela yekhonkolo ehla iye emgwaqeni. Amanani wesikhashana okufanele ahlolwe.
tpl.ex.daylight.name: Ukuhlangana nomhlaba
tpl.ex.daylight.note: Isibonelo: ukuthambeka kohlangothi kuya emhlabeni, nezilinganiso zawo zokusika nokugcwalisa. Amanani wesikhashana okufanele ahlolwe.
tpl.ex.ditch.name: Umfudlana
tpl.ex.ditch.note: Isibonelo: ukuthambeka kwangaphambili kuya ebhodweni elingqinile, bese kuba ukuthambeka kwangemuva kuya emhlabeni. Amanani wesikhashana okufanele ahlolwe.
tpl.ex.wall.name: Udonga oluqinisa
tpl.ex.wall.note: Isibonelo: udonga emaphethelweni olufika emhlabeni ekusikeni futhi lubambe umgwaqo ekugcwalisweni. Alikho isisekelo, akukho ukuklama: unjiniyela uklama udonga.
tpl.ex.topsoil.name: Inhlabathi engaphezulu ngaphansi komhlaba
tpl.ex.topsoil.note: Isibonelo sesifanekiso somhlaba: ingqimba yenhlabathi engaphezulu ngaphansi komhlaba. Ukujula okuyisikhashana okufanele kuhlolwe.
tpl.ex.parking.name: Ukufakwa nesisekelo emhlabeni
tpl.ex.parking.note: Isibonelo sesifanekiso somhlaba: isisekelo emhlabeni nomphezulu wendlela phezu kwesisekelo. Ukujula okuyisikhashana okufanele kuhlolwe.
gisa.tb.title: Ukuhlaziywa kwe-GIS: ibafa, ukubeka phezulu, ukuhlanganisa, ukukhetha ngesici nokulinganisa izingqimba ze-GIS
gisa.title: Ukuhlaziywa kwe-GIS
gisa.nolayers: Azikho izingqimba ze-GIS okwamanje. Vula i-shapefile, i-GeoJSON noma i-GeoPackage kuqala (GIS > Ngenisa).
gisa.note.skipped: Izici {n} zadlulwa (akukho bude, noma amaphoyinti amaningi kakhulu).
gisa.note.unmatched: Izici {n} azitholanga okuhambisanayo (zagcinwa, izinkambu ezihlanganisiwe zingenalutho).
gisa.buffer.lead: Idweba indawo yobude obuthile ozungeze yonke isici, njengengqimba entsha ye-polygon. Amaphoyinti nemigqa iyakhula; ama-polygon akhula, noma ancipha ngobude obungaphansi kweziro.
gisa.buffer.dissolve: Hlanganisa zonke izibafa zibe yisimo esisodwa
gisa.buffer.note: Izingxenye ezijikelezayo ziyizingcezu ezigudlile ngaphakathi kwesiyingi sangempela, ngakho ibafa lincane kancane kunevedlo langempela.
gisa.op.union: Umbuthano: gcina konke, usike lapho zihlangana khona
gisa.overlay.lead.intersect: Ingxenye ngayinye lapho isici sengqimba yokufaka sihlangana ne-polygon yengqimba yokubeka phezulu iba yisici esinezici zazo zombili izingqimba. Amaphoyinti nemigqa isikwa ngama-polygon.
gisa.overlay.lead.union: Izingqimba ze-polygon zombili ndawonye, zisikwe ngemiphetho yazo: izingxenye ezabelanayo zithwala izici zazo zombili izingqimba, ezinye zithwala eyodwa.
gisa.overlay.lead.erase: Ama-polygon okufaka aphuma nama-polygon okubeka phezulu. Izici zihlala nokufakwayo.
gisa.overlay.lead.dissolve: Ihlanganisa ama-polygon ahlangene noma ahlanganayo ibe yisimo esisodwa, wonke noma owodwa ngenani ngalinye lenkambu. Yengeza COUNT ne-AREA.
gisa.join.lead: Ikopisha izici zomthombo kuyo yonke isifinyelelo esihlangana nayo, njengengqimba entsha enesimo sesifinyelelo.
gisa.join.mode.summary: Zibale futhi uhlanganise izinkambu zazo zezinombolo
gisa.select.lead: Khetha izici ngombuzo mayelana nezici zazo noma nesimo sazo. Zidwetshwa kuplani; zenze ungqimba lwazo uma uthanda.
gisa.select.help: Izinkambu ngegama ("ngamagama anezikhala" uma linezikhala). Qhathanisa nge = != < <= > >=; umbhalo nge-contains, startswith, endswith, like; is null; in (a, b); between x and y; hlanganisa nge-and, or, not. Amanani esimo: $area, $perimeter, $length, $x, $y.
gisa.select.total.pg: Ama-polygon {count}, indawo ephelele {area} isikwele {unit}, ubude obuphelele obuzungezile {perimeter} {unit}.
gisa.measure.lead: Okuphelele kungqimba, izinkambu ezibamba indawo, ubude noma isikhundla sesici ngasinye, nezibalo zenkambu yezinombolo.
gisa.measure.calc: Engeza izinkambu zendawo, ubude noma X/Y kungqimba
gisa.stats.head: Izibalo
gisa.err.negative: Ama-polygon kuphela angancipha; amaphoyinti nemigqa kudingeka ubude obungaphezu kweziro.
gisa.err.toobig: Lezi zingqimba zinkulu kakhulu ukuze kuqhathaniswe izinto ngento. Qala unciphise enye yazo.
gisa.err.nothing: Umphumela awunalutho, ngakho akukho ungqimba oluengeziwe.
gist.tb.title: Ithebula lezici: hlela, hlunga, khetha, hlela amanani futhi ubale amanani ongqimba be-GIS
gist.title: Ithebula lezici
gist.none: Azikho izingqimba ze-GIS okwamanje. Qala ungenise ifayela.
gist.filter.ph: Isihlungi: isisho esifana ne-AREA > 500 futhi TYPE = 'oak', noma amagama okusesha
gist.mode.value: (akusona isisho: kufunwa amagama kuyo yonke ikholomu)
gist.edit.label: Inani lensimu {field}, umugqa {row}
gist.field.name: Igama lensimu elisha
gist.calc.lead: Bhala inani lomugqa ngamunye usebenzisa ezinye izinsimu, ijometri nemisebenzi ethile. Akukho okusebenza njengekhodi.
gist.calc.funcs: Imisebenzi: abs round floor ceil sqrt pow min max upper lower trim len substr left right replace concat coalesce if str num year month day. Umbhalo ubhalwa ngaphakathi kwamagatsha 'amancane', namagama ensimu anezikhala ngaphakathi kwezinkomba "ezimbili". $area $perimeter $length $x $y $vertices zifunda ijometri.
gist.calc.nulls: {n} imiphumela ayifanelanga uhlobo lwensimu futhi yashiywa ingenalutho.
gist.err.type: Leli nani alifanelani nohlobo lwensimu {type}. Akukho okushintshiwe.
gist.err.long: Igama lensimu lingaba nezinhlamvu ezi-64 kuphela.
gist.err.chars: Igama lensimu alikwazi ukuba nezinkomba, amabhulaketi noma izinhlamvu zokulawula.
gis.sym.title: Hlobisa {layer} ngokwesici
gis.sym.lead: Nikeza izinto zalolu ungqimba ({kind}) imibala ngokwamanani ensimu. Imibala ikhethwe ukuze ihlale icacile nakubantu abanobuthakathaka bokubona imibala.
gis.sym.ramp.viridis: Viridis (kusuka emnyama kuya ekhanyayo, ephephile kubantu abanobuthakathaka bokubona imibala)
gis.sym.ramp.cividis: Cividis (kusuka eluhlaza kuya kwegolide, ephephile kubantu abanobuthakathaka bokubona imibala)
gis.sym.size.range: Okuncane nokukhulu kakhulu (ngamamilimitha ephepha, uhhafu wohlangothi)
gis.sym.single.note: Ungqimba ligcina umbala owodwa. Khetha isitayela ukuze ubone izigaba zalo.
gis.sym.nofield: Khetha insimu yalesi sitayela (ngezinga kudingeka insimu yezinombolo).
gis.sym.approx: Imingcele yemvelo ibalwe ngamanani angu-1,500 ahlukaniswe ngokulinganayo.
gis.sym.manyvalues: Kunamanani amaningi kunemibala, ngakho amanani angavamile ahlanganiswa esigabeni esimpunga.
gis.sym.toomany: Izingqimba ezinezinto ezi-200,000 ezedlule zidwetshwa ngombala owodwa.
gis.sym.legend.head: {layer} ngokwensimu {field}

cv.corners.head: Amakhona
cv.corners.note: Thayipha i-easting ne-northing, noma ucindezele inkomba bese uchofoza indawo ku-ipulani. Ihlanganisa namaphoyinti okuhlola nezikhona namaPI asekudwetshiwe; bamba Alt ukuze ubeke ngokukhululeka.
cv.tan.head: Ithenjenti ngamaphoyinti amabili
cv.tan.note: Khetha amaphoyinti amabili ku-ipulani; ithenjenti okukhethiwe liphendulwe liqonde kusuka kokuqala liye kokwesibili, futhiligcine ubude balo.
cv.tan.have.a: Iphoyinti lokuqala likhethiwe. Manje khetha lesibili.
cv.tx.head: Hambisa, kopisha nezungeza
cv.tx.from.done: Iphoyinti lokuqala likhethiwe. Manje chofoza lapho kufanele kuye khona.
cv.tx.to.done: Ibanga ligcwaliswe. Cindezela Hambisa noma Kopisha.
cv.tx.note: Ukukopisha kugcina okokuqala lapho kunjalo futhi kukhethwa kamuva. Konke kuyisinyathelo sokuhlehlisa esisodwa.
cv.tx.copy.name: Ikopi: {name}
ui.grid.note: I-triangulation ixhuma amaphoyinti njengoba ekhona. Ezinye izindlela zihlela kuqala igridi evamile kumaphoyinti; imigqa yakho yokuhlukanisa nomkhawulo nayo isetshenziswa nazo. Umbiko wephansi ubonisa ukuthi umphumela useduze kangakanani namaphoyintiakho.
cv.grid.err.few: Kudingeka amaphoyinti amathathu noma ngaphezulu endaweni ehlukene ukuze kugridwe iphansi.
cv.grid.err.flat: Amaphoyinti ahlezi emugqeni, ngakho awakwazi ukwenza iphansi.
cv.grid.err.fit: Le ndlela ayikwazanga ukulinganisa lawa maphoyinti (izibalo zazingenayo impendulo eyodwa). Zama enye indlela.
cv.grid.err.nofaces: Igridi alinaseli eliphelele ngaphakathi kumaphoyinti. Zama ukuhlukana kwegridi okuncane.
